name: volume
meaning: VOLUME property (0..255): the maximum volume, scaled by distance or box falloff

name: soundHandle
meaning: current Sound channel handle, 0 = none; cleared when the channel is found stopped or on leaving range

name: loopPollCounter
meaning: looping mode only: incremented every in-range update; the IsPlaying / replay check runs only when it was even

name: repeatTimerMs
meaning: signed 24-bit bitfield (low 24 bits, top byte preserved): ms until the next one-shot play. -= g_dtMs while in range; plays when negative. Set by PickRepeatDelay as (s16)(MIN + rand(MAX-MIN+1)) | bit view of AmbientSoundManager +0x48: a 24-bit timer; the store masks the new value to 0xffffff and keeps the top byte (0x4949d3-0x4949ec)

name: repeatTimerTop
meaning: top byte of the repeat-timer unit, preserved by every store

name: playFlags
meaning: 7-bit bitfield of SoundPlayFlags passed as Sound_Play's 4th argument: 8 always; +2 POSITIONAL (FLAGS bit1) or +6 (bit2); +1 LOOP (bit3); +0x10 NO_ATTENUATION when linearFalloff or soundBox | bit view of AmbientSoundManager +0x4c: a 7-bit field updated as value |= 2 with the top bit preserved (0x494c6b-0x494c89)

name: playFlagsTop
meaning: top bit of the play-flags byte, preserved

name: linearFalloff
meaning: bit0 = FLAGS bit4: volume falls linearly with camera Manhattan-XZ distance over MAXDIST | signed bit view of AmbientSoundManager +0x50: shl 31 / sar 31 (0x494d25-0x494d2b)

name: soundBox
meaning: SOUNDBOX (Scn_GetPropBox prop 0x10): when set, the sound plays only while g_camPos is inside it and MAXDIST is ignored

name: maxVolBox
meaning: SOUNDMAXVOLBOX (prop 0x18): full volume inside; linear per-axis falloff out to the soundBox edges. If NULL, the falloff is measured from the object's pos
